text: bhikkhave bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā sarasaṅkappā saññojaniyā veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhunā abhibhūtametaṃ āyatanaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ hetaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti .pe. puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā sarasaṅkappā saññojaniyā veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhunā abhibhūtametaṃ āyatanaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ hetaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti . imāni vuccanti bhikkhave cha abhibhāyatanānīti . tatiyaṃ . [143] sāvatthīnidānaṃ .pe. pamādavihāriñca vo bhikkhave desissāmi appamādavihāriñca taṃ suṇātha . kathañca bhikkhave
